_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Non-engineers can edit values here. Anything marked TODO is an unverified business fact and MUST NOT be published as a claim until confirmed. Flip launchStatus.mode to 'live' ONLY after every item in docs/ASSUMPTIONS-AND-MISSING-FACTS.md 'Blocking before LIVE MODE' is satisfied.

brand.name: Doctors of Natural Medicine
brand._establishedYearNote: drnatmed.com Colorado Springs page states 'In 2016 we set ourselves out on a mission'. Used only to describe Colorado history, never California tenure.
brand.foundingStory: Doctors of Natural Medicine has operated medical cannabis evaluation clinics across Colorado — in Colorado Springs, Lakewood, Fort Collins, and Pueblo — since 2016.

launchStatus.launchBanner: California service — launching soon. Join the notify list below; no bookings or payments are being taken yet.
launchStatus.liveBanner: Now serving patients located in California by telemedicine.
launchStatus._bookingEnabledNote: Hard-gated by build.py. Even if set true, LIVE MODE requires a configured, verified booking provider in integrations.booking.

pricing._publishedNote: Keep false until California fees are approved. When false, pages show a transparent 'pricing confirmed before launch' message instead of a number.
pricing.notApprovedPolicy: TODO_CONFIRM: Written refund/not-approved policy for California. Do NOT reuse Colorado's policy or copy a competitor's money-back wording until legal/clinical sign-off.
pricing.whatsIncluded: TODO_CONFIRM: exact list of what the fee includes (consultation, recommendation letter, re-issue, support). State 'no hidden fees' only if true.
pricing.stateMmicFeeNote: Separate from our fee: the optional county MMIC costs up to $100 per application/renewal (50% off for Medi-Cal), set and collected by your county — not by us.

physicians._verifiedNote: Keep false until at least one California-licensed MD/DO is contracted and consents to being listed with license-verification link. While false, the physicians section shows a credential-standard statement, not fake bios.

coloradoAggregate._sourceNote: Stated on drnatmed.com homepage. Label clearly as Colorado reviews. Do NOT present as California telemedicine feedback.
coloradoAggregate.label: Reviews from our Colorado patients

californiaReviews._note: Empty until we have approved, attributable California telemedicine reviews with consent and source links.

booking._providerNote: demo-adapter NEVER confirms a real appointment. Replace with the approved, BAA-covered scheduling vendor before LIVE MODE. Confirm HIPAA BAA, privacy config, and that no PHI leaks to analytics.

forms._endpointNote: Public inquiry/notify/recruitment forms post minimal contact data to an approved endpoint (e.g., a serverless function or vetted form provider). NEVER collect diagnoses, medical history, or ID documents in public forms. CV uploads disabled until secure storage + access controls exist.

analytics._enabledNote: Disabled in preview. When enabled, use a privacy-respecting analytics tool configured per docs/MEASUREMENT-PRIVACY.md. No advertising pixels or session replay anywhere. Never send PHI, form answers, documents, or sensitive URL params.

entity._confirmedNote: California's corporate practice of medicine doctrine (Bus. & Prof. Code sec. 2400) generally bars a non-licensed corporation from employing physicians. The marketing/administrative business and the professional medical entity that delivers care are likely distinct. Name them accurately ONLY once the structure and MSO/PC relationship is legally confirmed.
entity.relationshipStatement: TODO: one sentence describing how the administrative brand supports an independent California professional medical entity whose physicians exercise independent clinical judgment.

contact.notifyConsentText: I agree to receive launch updates about the California service. I can unsubscribe anytime. This is separate from any clinical consent.
contact._mailingAddressNote: No California street address, map, or local listing is published — the service is telemedicine-only. Do not fabricate a CA office.

legal.medicalReviewer: TODO: Only state 'medically reviewed by <name>, <credential>' after a qualified clinician actually reviews the content. Do not fabricate.
